result.brief: 将合成视频生成到真实机器人轨迹的零样本操作形式化为约束优化，分析视频生成需在语义吸引域内播种搜索。
result.reason: Uses synthetic generated videos as trajectory priors for robot manipulation, formalizing video-to-trajectory transfer as constrained optimization; main contribution is robot policy/planning, so secondary world-model application.
